chunks: Abul Ḥusain Aḥmad ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn ‘Ali Al-Nāqid narrated to me through his Isnād, he said: ‘Umar ibn Sa’d said: Abū Ma’shar narrated to me from Al-Zuhri,
When Ḥusain (a.s.) was killed, no stone was left in Bayt Al-Maqdis without finding fresh blood under it.
ai.seo_question: What is the sign of Imam Husain's killing in Jerusalem according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the cosmic resonance of Imam al-Husain’s (a.s.) martyrdom, asserting that the blood of the Ahl al-Bayt permeated the earth even in distant holy sites like Jerusalem. It underscores the Shia belief in the metaphysical connection between the Imam’s sacrifice and the physical world, serving as a spiritual sign for pilgrims to deepen their reverence during ziyarat.
